disease_label_per_paper: Primary Sjogren's syndrome presenting as mass-like encephalitis with progression to neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
presentation_summary: 43-year-old woman presented with acute fever, headache, dysarthria, amnesia, left-sided weakness and dysesthesia.
Brain CT/MRI showed a 7-cm mass-like right frontoparietal lesion largely composed of edema with additional corpus callosum and periventricular lesions.
She reported dry mouth for 10 years; blood tests showed ANA 1:320 and anti-SSA/Ro positive; dry-eye examinations were positive and minor salivary gland biopsy had focus score >2.
